reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and nothing here says the fixtures are UL listed. I'm not hanging a $360 pendant from my ceiling on a hunch, and I need things in hand fast.
objection: Is it UL listed and safe, and will my electrician install it? 10 to 12 business days is already pushing my deadline, and made-to-order at 6 weeks is out. Plus I pay return shipping on a big fragile box if it looks wrong.
would_change_my_mind: UL/ETL listing shown on the product page, a real in-stock ship date I can count on within a week, and free returns or reviews from verified buyers with photos.
